# Merge Decision Packet Template (TBF-1)

Terminal-0 authors this; merge readiness requires it. Green CI alone is never sufficient. Must record:
policy version+digest (ACTIVE); lane obligations validated; evidence complete + hashes verified;
exact-SHA CI current; checker satisfied; founder witness/signature where required; no active
qualification contract prohibiting merge; the chosen integration topology; rollback plan; and the
`validate_merge_readiness.py` derived result.
